title: Shadownet extension fields on the A2A AgentCard
description: Fields added by the Shadownet extension to an A2A AgentCard. Defined in rfcs/0001-shadownet.md §5.3. The full AgentCard structure (name, supportedInterfaces, capabilities, signatures, etc.) is defined by the A2A specification; this schema covers only the Shadownet-specific additions and the required extension declaration.

shadownet:pk.description: The Shadow's signing public key, multibase-encoded Ed25519 (base58btc, multicodec 0xed01). Self-describing via the z6Mk prefix.

capabilities.description: A2A AgentCapabilities. MUST declare the Shadownet extension as required.

extensions.description: MUST contain at least one entry with uri == 'urn:shadownet:0.2' and required == true.
